title: Donda [Alternate Cover 1]
description: This album cover is inspired by an art piece by French-American artist Louise Bourgeois. The original artwork was part of a collection titled Les têtes bleues et les femmes rouges, which translates as The blue heads and the red women. Bourgeois would often make art to work through the trauma of losing her mother at a young age. This theme resonates with Kanye's dedication of DONDA to his late mother, who passed away in 2007.

title: YEEZY BOOST 380 KIDS
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 380 Kids ‘Hylte’ delivers an eye-catching colorway of the minimalist slip-on silhouette. The re-engineered Primeknit upper is rendered in a mix of mustard yellow and honeyed tan hues, while the translucent monofilament window is distinguished by an eye-catching neon green finish. Lightweight cushioning comes courtesy of a full-length Boost midsole, wrapped in a grey rubber cage and supported by a herringbone rubber outsole. The Yeezy Boost 380 Kids 'Hylte’ is a regional exclusive and only launched in North America and Latin America.

title: YEEZY BOOST 380
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 380 ‘Hylte Glow’ updates the minimalist silhouette with an energetic color scheme made up of yellow and tan hues throughout the re-engineered Primeknit upper. The resulting camo-like design is treated to a green-tinged glow-in-the-dark finish, matching the dayglow shade applied to the sneaker’s translucent monofilament window. The bright tones are tempered by the midsole, featuring full-length Boost encased in dark grey rubber. The Yeezy Boost 380 ‘Hylte Glow’ is a regional exclusive and only launched in North America and Latin America.

title: YEEZY 500 HIGH
description: The adidas Yeezy 500 High ‘Sumac’ treats the bulky silhouette to a unique palette made up of rich earth tones and sharply contrasting primary colors. The upper is constructed from brown mesh with tonal suede overlays at the toe and heel. They’re joined by midfoot suede overlays in blue and indigo, along with bold a crimson overlay that wraps around the collar and snakes underneath the stitched-on eyelets. The sneaker is mounted on a podular adiPRENE+ that offers lightweight cushioning with each step.
